For the In-doped samples, the negative MD effect and subsequent transformation to the positive MD effect originate from the field-dependent non-collinear spin ordering and electron hopping, respectively. The MD effect at high temperatures is attributed to the combination of magnetoresistance and Maxwell-Wagner effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究了Ga3+和In3+阳离子掺杂对M型BaFe12O19陶瓷磁性、介电和磁电性能的影响。研究发现，Ga3+和In3+由于取代位置不同，导致了样品物理特性的显著差异，包括磁性转变和介电行为。介电特性在不同温度范围归因于量子顺电态、电子跳跃、偶极玻璃态和界面极化等多种机制。
authors: Yang Yang, Run-Yu Lei, Jian-Ping Zhou, Xiao-Ming Chen

articles.title: Coexisting Charge Density Wave and Superconducting Order in Quantizing Magnetic Fields
articles.title_zh: 量子化磁场中电荷密度波与超导序的共存
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05039v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge density wave (CDW) and superconductivity are both common in strongly interacting electron systems. While CDW order is ubiquitous in both quantum Hall systems and unconventional superconductors, superconductivity is generally suppressed by the strong magnetic fields required for Landau quantization. Here we investigate the intertwined CDW and superconducting phases of rhombohedral hexalayer graphene (R6G) in a large displacement field, which generates tunable flat band edges, and a strong magnetic field, which generates a manifold of nearly degenerate Landau levels. CDW order is accompanied by pronounced thermal hysteresis as expected for first-order melting transitions. Surprisingly, we find a series of strong integer quantum Hall effects at magnetic fields above ~2T with Hall conductance quantum numbers that deviate strongly from nearby integer filling factors, an observation that can be explained only by CDW order that mixes many Landau levels. We also find a nearby superconducting phase that is stabilized by perpendicular magnetic fields and persists deep within the quantum Hall regime. The CDW and superconducting phases develop on comparable temperature scales and emerge from the same manifold of strongly mixed Landau levels. These observations provide new insight into the interplay between superconductivity and CDW order in R6G at zero magnetic field.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了菱形六层石墨烯（R6G）在强位移场和强磁场下电荷密度波（CDW）与超导相的交织共存现象。CDW序表现出热滞后，表明其为一级熔化转变。研究还观察到在量子霍尔效应中，霍尔电导量子数显著偏离整数填充因子，这可以通过CDW混合多个朗道能级来解释。此外，发现了一个由垂直磁场稳定并深入量子霍尔区域的超导相。
authors: Ron Q. Nguyen, Peiyu Qin, Hai-Tian Wu, Sparsh Mishra, Tobias Wolf, Joseph Roll, Erin Morissette, Naiyuan J. Zhang, Sarah Alkidim, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Aaron W. Hui, Dima E. Feldman, Allan MacDonald, J. I. A. Li

articles.title: Platinum is a Photocatalyst: Large Visible-Light Quantum Efficiency Revealed
articles.title_zh: 铂是一种光催化剂：揭示其在可见光下的高量子效率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05172v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metal-semiconductor junctions in optoelectronic devices are commonly engineered to promote charge separation. In Pt/TiO2 Schottky junctions, Pt is typically regarded as a catalytic electron sink rather than a visible-light-active component. Here, we demonstrate that Pt nanoislands on TiO2 can generate photochemically active carriers under visible light excitation. Using quantitative scanning photoelectrochemical microscopy, we measure the wavelength-resolved external quantum efficiency (EQE) of Au and Pt nanoisland arrays on TiO2, and correlate their reactivity with their morphology and extinction spectra. Discrete 10 nm Pt nanoislands exhibit robust broadband visible light photoactivity - exceeding the photoactivity of similar-sized Au nanoislands under blue-green excitation - whereas Pt's photoactivity is strongly suppressed when the nanoislands are connected. Surprisingly, Pt exhibits an EQE-per-atom approx. 20 times higher than Au at 455 nm and approx. 2 times higher at 595 nm (at Au's optimum). We show an approximately wavelength-independent Pt internal quantum efficiency of approx. 1 percent across the visible spectral region. These findings reposition catalytic metals with strongly damped optical response in the visible as light-responsive components in metal-semiconductor hybrids, challenging the prevailing perception that they function solely as passive co-catalysts in photocatalytic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了二氧化钛上的铂纳米岛在可见光激发下能够产生光化学活性载流子，从而作为一种光催化剂。通过定量扫描光电化学显微镜测量了金和铂纳米岛阵列的波长分辨外部量子效率（EQE）。研究发现，离散的10纳米铂纳米岛表现出强大的宽带可见光光活性，在蓝绿色激发下甚至超过了相同尺寸的金纳米岛。铂在可见光区域展现出约1%的内部量子效率，并且在特定波长下其单位原子EQE远高于金。
authors: Olivier Henrotte, Yin Chak Wong, Jordan Edwards, Simão Meneses João, Štěpán Kment, Emiliano Cortés, Johannes Lischner, Alberto Naldoni

articles.title: Near itinerancy and slow singlet formation in the triangular lattice NaRuO2
articles.title_zh: 三角晶格NaRuO2中的近巡游性和缓慢单线态形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05287v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: NaRuO₂ forms a delafossite-like structure that contains triangular sublattices of edge-sharing RuO₆ octahedra. It shows no evidence of magnetic order down to 100 mK and persistent spin fluctuations, suggestive of a quantum disordered magnetic ground state. In order to characterize the physical regime from which this disordered state arises, we use resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) and X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) at the Ru-L₂,₃-edge, along with pulsed high-field magnetization to characterize both the local electronic structure and the magnetic interactions. Despite significant spin-orbit coupling inferred from XAS measurements, a spin-orbit exciton, characteristic of a spin-orbit assisted Mott insulator, was not observed with RIXS due to the presence of damped intraorbital excitations, which are characteristic of a metal. Corroborated by models of the high-field magnetization to a random singlet model, we propose a picture of a nearly itinerant system with strong magnetic and charge fluctuations that destabilize long-range magnetic order.
articles.abstract_zh: NaRuO₂形成一种具有RuO₆八面体三角亚晶格的层状结构，在低至100 mK的温度下未显示磁有序，并存在持续的自旋涨落。本研究利用共振非弹性X射线散射、X射线吸收光谱和脉冲强磁场磁化测量，表征了其局部电子结构和磁相互作用。研究提出NaRuO₂是一个具有强磁性和电荷涨落的近巡游体系，这些涨落抑制了长程磁有序的形成。
authors: Charles C. Tam, Alon Hendler Avidor, Pritam Bhattacharyya, Yongseong Choi, Daniel Haskel, Sven Luther, Hlynur Gretarrson, Liviu Hozoi, Stephen D. Wilson

articles.title: Electron-beam Writing of Spectrally Uniform Green Single-photon Emitters in Hexagonal Boron Nitride
articles.title_zh: 六方氮化硼中光谱均匀绿色单光子发射器的电子束写入
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02855v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Scalable quantum photonic technologies require single-photon emitters whose positions and emission energies can be engineered simultaneously. Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) is an attractive room-temperature host, but deterministic creation of spectrally reproducible emitters remains challenging. Here, we use a standard scanning electron microscope as a direct-writing tool to activate bright green single-photon emitters in hBN at predefined sites, without ion implantation or post-fabrication thermal annealing. The written emitters exhibit reproducible zero-phonon-line emission centered near 536 nm, room-temperature antibunching with g(2)(0) as low as 0.08, high brightness, strong linear polarization, and stable emission. Thickness-dependent activation, stacking experiments, cathodoluminescence spectroscopy, and first-principles calculations support a carbon-related defect complex as the most plausible origin of the emission. As a proof of nanophotonic compatibility, we further activate emitters in a nanoparticle-on-mirror plasmonic nanocavity and observe photoluminescence enhancement accompanied by shortened emission lifetimes. These results establish electron-beam direct writing as a practical route to site-selective, spectrally uniform green quantum emitters in hBN, offering a promising basis for integrated room-temperature quantum photonic architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 可扩展的量子光子技术需要可控位置和发射能量的单光子发射器。本研究利用标准扫描电子显微镜作为直接写入工具，在六方氮化硼（hBN）中预定位置激活了明亮的绿色单光子发射器，无需离子注入或后处理退火。这些发射器展现出可重现的零声子线发射、室温反聚束效应、高亮度、强线性偏振和稳定发射。结合实验和理论计算，研究认为碳相关缺陷复合体是其发射的可能来源，并验证了其与纳米光子学的兼容性。
authors: Qingsong Tao, Fuyi Zhou, Zhijie Li, Yihao Yan, Shuangyue Li, Yuelan Gao, Zijing Wu, Yizhou Liu, Tao Liang, Shuai Yuan, Dakun Wu, Hongzhi Zhou, Qi Zhang, Zhenyi Ni, Chunlei Yu, Pan Wang, Fei Yu, Lili Hu, Ning Zhou

articles.title: Dark energy genesis: modeling dissipative effects in primordial cosmology
articles.title_zh: 暗能量起源：原初宇宙中耗散效应的建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.03272v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In various approaches to quantum gravity, spacetime geometry is understood to emerge from more fundamental discrete structures at the Planck scale. As sometimes posited, their presence could lead to dissipative effects in the smooth effective sector. In this paper, we develop the idea of non-conservation in gravity, by introducing an effective cosmological model within unimodular gravity, in which a varying cosmological constant arises as a consequence of dissipation. We show that this requires to incorporate hidden degrees of freedom -- termed quantum gravity defects -- that act as an effective bath for the matter fields. To illustrate the viability of the framework, we study the case of an Ohmic bath inspired by the Caldeira-Leggett model for Brownian motion, leading to a diffusion equation for the matter energy density. The results show that, starting from a primordial universe with no dark energy, dissipation can account for the generation of a small positive cosmological constant.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了量子引力中时空几何从离散结构涌现可能导致的耗散效应。研究在一个有效宇宙学模型中，引入了非守恒引力思想，其中可变的宇宙学常数源于耗散作用。这需要引入隐藏的自由度（量子引力缺陷）作为物质场的有效浴。通过欧姆浴模型，结果表明耗散可以从一个没有暗能量的原初宇宙中产生一个小的正宇宙学常数。
authors: Pietro Pellecchia, Alejandro Perez, Salvatore Ribisi

articles.title: Mid-IR single- and dual-electro-optic comb generation with an ultrafast modulator
articles.title_zh: 利用超快电光调制器生成中红外单梳和双梳
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.03317v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Mid-infrared (mid-IR) frequency combs are powerful tools for molecular sensing, industrial monitoring, and precision spectroscopy, yet their development beyond 5 um remains limited. Electro-optic modulation offers a promising path toward compact, agile comb generation, but extending this approach into the mid-infrared has been hindered by the lack of practical, high-performance modulators. Here we present an approach that leads to efficient generation of mid infrared frequency combs around 9 um, by employing ultrafast, room temperature, free space electro optic intensity modulators. By driving a single modulator with short electrical pulse trains, we realize both single- and dual-comb operation from a continuous-wave quantum cascade laser, providing a compact and versatile platform for mid-IR spectroscopy. This scheme produces combs with tunable repetition rates down to the megahertz range with direct observation on an electrical spectrum analyzer without any interferometer. As a proof of concept, we perform single- and dual-comb spectroscopy of a germanium etalon and an ammonia cell, achieving resolution far beyond that of conventional Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectrometers and highlighting the potential of this approach for precise measurements in the long-wavelength molecular-fingerprint region. These results establish high-performance mid-IR modulators as a promising route toward practical, energy-efficient frequency-comb systems for sensing and spectroscopy.
articles.abstract_zh: 中红外频率梳是分子传感和精密光谱学的强大工具，但其在5微米以上的发展受限。本研究提出了一种利用超快、室温、自由空间电光强度调制器，在9微米附近高效生成中红外频率梳的方法。通过用短电脉冲序列驱动单个调制器，实现了连续波量子级联激光器的单梳和双梳操作，提供了一个紧凑且多功能的平台。该方案能够产生重复率可调至兆赫兹范围的频率梳，并已通过对锗标准具和氨气室的单梳和双梳光谱测量验证了其高分辨率。
authors: Gia-Long Ngo, Luca Lucia, Stefano Pirotta, Mario Malerba, Lianhe H Li, Stefano Barbieri, Victor Merupo, Edmund H Linfield, Benoit Darquié, Jean-Michel Manceau, Adel Bousseksou, Raffaele Colombelli

articles.title: Circle of Alpha-Particle Cluster Shapes in Neon-20
articles.title_zh: 氖-20中α粒子团簇形状的循环
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.03917v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum states of Neon-20 are generally agreed to lie in rotational-vibrational bands of a cluster of five alpha particles. However, more than one cluster shape has been proposed as dominant at low energy. As relative motion within a cluster is soft in certain directions, we investigate how the low-lying rotational bands of Neon-20 can arise from a circle of clusters connecting favoured shapes: a triangular bipyramid, a square pyramid, and a D₂d-symmetric distorted tetrahedron -- a twisted bow-tie. Motion around the circle extends the Berry pseudo-rotation that connects differently oriented bipyramids.
articles.abstract_zh: 氖-20的量子态通常被认为是五个α粒子团簇的转动-振动带。本研究探讨了氖-20的低能转动带如何从连接三角形双锥体、四方锥体和D₂d对称扭曲四面体等优选形状的“团簇循环”中产生。这种围绕循环的运动扩展了连接不同取向双锥体的贝里赝转动。
authors: N. S. Manton

articles.title: Entanglement of excited states after measurements in conformal field theory
articles.title_zh: 共形场论中测量后激发态的纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.04268v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the entanglement of low-energy excited states after a fixed-outcome projective measurement on a spatial interval in a (1+1)-dimensional conformal field theory (CFT). The post-selected measurement outcome is represented by a slit carrying a conformal boundary condition, while excited states are introduced by operator insertions in the Euclidean path integral. After mapping the replicated slit geometry to a disk, the excited-state contribution to the post-measurement Rényi entropy is expressed as a normalized boundary-CFT correlation function. We apply this framework to the compact free boson CFT. For the chiral current excitation, the relevant ratios are given by current hafnians. We also study coherent superpositions of J and bar J, and of conjugate compact vertex operators. In the conjugate-vertex case, the ordinary-cylinder second Rényi ratio is independent of the relative phase, whereas the finite-slit post-measurement ratio contains phase-sensitive interference terms. Finally, we describe free-fermion and multi-Slater determinant methods for testing these predictions in the critical XX chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在(1+1)维共形场论（CFT）中，对空间区间进行固定结果投影测量后低能激发态的纠缠。通过将复制的狭缝几何映射到圆盘，测量后激发态对Rényi熵的贡献被表示为归一化的边界CFT关联函数。研究将此框架应用于紧致自由玻色子CFT，并探讨了手征电流激发以及共轭紧致顶点算符的相干叠加。结果表明，在共轭顶点情况下，有限狭缝测量后的Rényi比率包含相位敏感的干涉项。
authors: Hui-Huang Chen

articles.title: Speed limits on biomolecular processes from fundamental physical constants
articles.title_zh: 基本物理常数对生物分子过程的速度限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.04549v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many of the timescales of life have speed limits set by quantum-mechanical constraints along with non-fundamental quantities, such as the temperature of the environment, which are however bounded by anthropic considerations. Here, some of such speed limits are examined, including those for the rates of elementary chemical reactions and biomolecular folding. Limitations of simple back-of-envelope estimates are also discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 生命中的许多时间尺度都受到量子力学约束和非基本量（如环境温度，受人择原理限制）设定的速度限制。本文探讨了其中一些速度限制，包括基本化学反应和生物分子折叠的速率限制。研究还讨论了简单估算方法的局限性。
authors: Dmitrii E Makarov

articles.title: Effective Field Theory of Noncritical M-theory from Bosonization
articles.title_zh: 基于玻色化的非临界M理论的有效场论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05143v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We extend the coadjoint orbit approach to bosonization systematized by Delacretaz-Du-Mehta-Son to double-scaled non-relativistic Fermi liquids with central inverted harmonic oscillator potential. In 1+1d, this reproduces the Das-Jevicki collective field theory describing quasiparticle excitations of the c=1 matrix model. In 2+1d, this yields an effective field theory for noncritical M-theory, namely the 2+1d Fermi liquid proposed by Hořava and Keeler as a unified framework for characterizing noncritical string vacua. With a suitable gauge choice this theory reduces to a continuous family of 1+1d chiral bosons resembling Das-Jevicki collective fields coupled by additional interactions. Utilizing the underlying integrability of noncritical M-theory, we compute select fermion density correlation functions order-by-order in perturbation theory, and provide evidence that they agree with their Fermi liquid counterparts in a suitable semiclassical limit. This represents a step toward an effective spacetime gravity description of noncritical M-theory, which we expect to shed light on both the landscape of 2d noncritical strings and 3d quantum gravity in general.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将协同轨道玻色化方法扩展到具有中心倒谐振子势的双标度非相对论费米液体。在1+1维中，这再现了描述c=1矩阵模型准粒子激发的Das-Jevicki集体场论。在2+1维中，它产生了非临界M理论的有效场论。研究利用非临界M理论的积分性，计算了选定的费米子密度关联函数，并提供了它们在半经典极限下与费米液体对应物一致的证据。
authors: Patrick Jefferson, Tokiro Numasawa

articles.title: Calibration of systematic distortions in quantum emitter localization microscopy for deterministic nanophotonic fabrication
articles.title_zh: 量子发射器定位显微镜中系统畸变的校准及其在确定性纳米光子制造中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05370v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum photonic technologies greatly benefit from quantum light emitters with high brightness, indistinguishability, and reliable polarization characteristics. Achieving optimal performance relies on the accurate localization of emitters and their deterministic integration into tailored photonic structures with nanometer-scale accuracy. Although marker-based photoluminescence imaging techniques can achieve statistical fitting uncertainties below 10 nm, the ultimate integration yield is often limited by uncorrected systematic distortions in custom cryo-optical setups that compromise metrological accuracy. Here, we present an in situ calibration protocol that uses lithographically defined gold nanodisk arrays as references to calibrate optical distortions with a Zernike vector-field model. On held-out validation patterns beyond the calibration dataset, this correction reduces the residual systematic bias to 5.3 nm with a 2D scatter of 24.6 nm across the analyzed field of view. Furthermore, we demonstrate that applying this correction to the deterministic fabrication of circular mesa structures around semiconductor quantum dots reduces the variance in emission polarization by 49%, indicating improved registration accuracy. This calibration strategy offers a practical route to high-yield deterministic integration of quantum emitters into scalable quantum photonic circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子光子技术依赖于量子发射器的精确定位和确定性集成。本研究提出了一种原位校准协议，利用光刻定义的金纳米盘阵列作为参考，通过Zernike矢量场模型校准低温光学设置中的系统畸变。该方法将残余系统偏差降低至5.3纳米，并在分析视场内实现了24.6纳米的二维散射。将此校正应用于半导体量子点周围圆形台面结构的确定性制造，显著提高了集成良率。
authors: Chenxi Ma, Maximilian Heller, Timon Handrup, Yiteng Zhang, Tobias M. Krieger, Thomas Oberleitner, Zenghui Jiang, Xian Zheng, Eddy P. Rugeramigabo, Folke Dencker, Armando Rastelli, Fei Ding, Michael Zopf

articles.title: Spin sensitive transport in RuCl₃/Pt heterostructures: revealing a field-transverse spin anisotropy in a spin liquid candidate
articles.title_zh: RuCl₃/Pt异质结构中的自旋敏感输运：揭示自旋液体候选材料中的场横向自旋各向异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2204.03158v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Alpha-phase (a-) RuCl₃ has emerged as a possible candidate for a quantum spin liquid (QSL) that promises exotic quasi-particles relevant for fault-tolerant quantum computation. Here, we report spin-sensitive transport measurements using a proximal spin Hall metal -- platinum (Pt) -- to probe magnetic moments in the insulator a-RuCl₃. We observe a spin Hall magnetoresistance (SMR) where both the transverse and longitudinal resistivities of a-RuCl₃/Pt exhibit oscillations as functions of the angle between the in-plane magnetic field and the current, arising from the interplay between the spin Hall effect in Pt and local magnetic moments in a-RuCl3. The oscillations are observed from 1.5 T to 18 T, spanning the range of magnetic fields where zig-zag antiferromagnetic phase, the putative QSL phase, and the partially field-polarized states are reported in a-RuCl₃. The phase of the SMR oscillations suggest that the local moments, regardless of static or fluctuating, in a-RuCl₃ develop an anisotropy with an in-plane quantization axis that aligns largely transverse to the magnetic field for all fields above 1.5 T. Temperature dependance of the SMR revealed that the spin anisotropy has a similar energy scale to reported QSL signatures in a-RuCl₃. The coupling between the spin states within a-RuCl₃ and Pt demonstrated in our experiment opens a transport route to exploring exotic spin phases and device functionalities of QSL materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了在量子自旋液体候选材料α-RuCl₃/Pt异质结构中进行的自旋敏感输运测量。研究观察到自旋霍尔磁阻（SMR）振荡，这表明Pt中的自旋霍尔效应与RuCl₃中的局域磁矩之间存在相互作用。SMR振荡的相位揭示了RuCl₃中局域磁矩的平面内量子化轴，在1.5 T以上的磁场中，该轴主要与磁场横向对齐。
authors: H. Idzuchi, M. Kimata, S. Okamoto, P. Laurell, N. Mohanta, M. Cothrine, S. E. Nagler, D. Mandrus, A. Banerjee, Y. P. Chen

articles.title: Generalized Dynamical Duality of Quantum Particles in One Dimension
articles.title_zh: 一维量子粒子广义动力学对偶性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.25056v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We prove a generalized dynamical duality for identical particles in one dimension (1D). Namely, 1D systems with arbitrary statistics -- including bosons, fermions and anyons -- approach the same momentum distribution after long-time expansion from a trap, provided they share the same scattering length for short-range interactions. This momentum distribution is uniquely given by the rapidities, or quasi-momenta, of the initial trapped state. Our results can be readily detected in quasi-1D ultracold gases with tunable s- and p-wave interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了一维（1D）中相同粒子的广义动力学对偶性。研究表明，具有任意统计特性（包括玻色子、费米子和任意子）的一维系统，在从陷阱中长时间膨胀后，会趋近于相同的动量分布。这种动量分布由初始受困态的准动量唯一确定，该结果可在准一维超冷气体中通过可调s波和p波相互作用进行检测。
authors: Yu Chen, Xiaoling Cui

articles.title: A Hydrodynamic Theory for Non-Equilibrium Full Counting Statistics in One-Dimensional Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 一维量子系统中非平衡全计数统计的流体动力学理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.05954v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the dynamics of charge fluctuations after homogeneous quantum quenches in one-dimensional systems with ballistic transport. For short but macroscopic times where the non-trivial dynamics is largely dominated by long-range correlations, a simple expression for the associated full counting statistics can be obtained by hydrodynamic arguments. This formula links the non-equilibrium charge fluctuation after the quench to the fluctuations of the associated current after a charge-biased inhomogeneous modification of the original quench which corresponds to the paradigmatic partitioning protocol. Under certain assumptions, the fluctuations in the latter case can be expressed by explicit closed form formulas in terms of thermodynamic and hydrodynamic quantities via the Ballistic Fluctuations Theory. In this work, we identify precise physical conditions for the applicability of a fully hydrodynamic theory, and provide a detailed analysis explicitly demonstrating how such conditions are met and how this leads to such hydrodynamic treatment. We discuss these conditions at length in non-relativistic free fermions, where calculations become feasible and allow for cross-checks against exact results. In physically relevant cases, strong long-range correlations can complicate the hydrodynamic picture, but our formula still correctly reproduces the first cumulants.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一维弹道输运系统中均匀量子猝灭后电荷涨落的动力学。研究提出了一种流体动力学理论，用于在短但宏观的时间尺度上获得相关全计数统计的简单表达式。该公式将猝灭后的非平衡电荷涨落与电荷偏置非均匀猝灭（即划分协议）后相关电流的涨落联系起来。文中详细阐述了该流体动力学理论的适用物理条件，并以非相对论自由费米子为例进行了验证。
authors: David X. Horvath, Benjamin Doyon, Paola Ruggiero

articles.title: Scale Invariance Breaking and Discrete Phase Invariance in Few-Body Problems
articles.title_zh: 少体问题中的标度不变性破缺与离散相位不变性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.09266v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Scale invariance in quantum mechanics can be broken in several ways. A well-known example is the breakdown of continuous scale invariance to discrete scale invariance, whose typical realization is the Efimov effect of three-body problems. Here we discuss yet another discrete symmetry to which continuous scale invariance can be broken: discrete phase invariance. We first revisit the one-body problem on the half line in the presence of an inverse-square potential -- the simplest example of nontrivial scale-invariant quantum mechanics -- and show that continuous scale invariance can be broken to discrete phase invariance in a small window of coupling constant. We also show that discrete phase invariance manifests itself as circularly distributed simple poles on Riemann sheets of the S-matrix. We then present three examples of few-body problems that exhibit discrete phase invariance. These examples are the one-body Aharonov-Bohm problem, a two-body problem of nonidentical particles in two dimensions, and a three-body problem of nonidentical particles in one dimension, all of which contain a codimension-two ``magnetic'' flux in configuration spaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了量子力学中连续标度不变性如何破缺为离散相位不变性，这与离散标度不变性（如Efimov效应）不同。研究首先重新审视了半线上存在反平方势的单体问题，揭示了在特定耦合常数范围内离散相位不变性的出现。随后，文章提出了三个少体问题（包括Aharonov-Bohm问题、二维非相同粒子两体问题和一维非相同粒子三体问题）作为展示离散相位不变性的例子。
authors: Satoshi Ohya

articles.title: Quantum Thermalization beyond Non-Integrability and Quantum Scars in a Multispecies Bose-Josephson Junction
articles.title_zh: 多物种玻色-约瑟夫森结中超越非可积性的量子热化与量子疤痕
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.25829v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The modern framework for quantum thermalization is grounded in the Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis (ETH), in which non-integrability and chaos are historically assumed as prerequisites. This work investigates this relationship in a three-species Bose-Josephson Junction (BJJ) with mutual interactions, experimentally achievable in current ultracold-atom platforms. After a thorough characterization of quantum chaos in this system, we examine the occurrence of thermal behavior expected when ETH holds. We identify three distinct regimes: chaotic, integrable, and separable. Remarkably, quantum thermalization occurs in both the chaotic and integrable regimes, while it breaks down in and near the separable limit - supporting that non-integrability is not a necessary condition for thermalization. Furthermore, since the system exhibits collective phenomena in the semiclassical limit, we identify ergodicity breaking phenomena such as athermal states in the chaotic regime classifiable as quantum scars, which show no signs of thermalization, consistently with a weak form of ETH.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了三物种玻色-约瑟夫森结（BJJ）中的量子热化和量子疤痕现象。研究发现，量子热化在混沌和可积两种机制下均可发生，这挑战了非可积性是热化先决条件的传统假设。此外，在混沌机制中识别出非热态，即量子疤痕，这些疤痕与弱形式的本征态热化假说（ETH）相符。
authors: Francesco Di Menna, Sergio Ciuchi, Simone Paganelli

articles.title: The Hermitian Hull Dimensions for a Class of (L,P)-Twisted Generalized Reed-Solomon Codes
articles.title_zh: 一类(L,P)-扭曲广义Reed-Solomon码的厄米特核维数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.03802v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Determining the hull of linear codes has long been an important topic in coding theory. Recently, non-generalized Reed-Solomon (in short, non-GRS) codes have attracted extensive research interest. The (L,P)-twisted generalized Reed-Solomon (in short, (L,P)-TGRS) code, which is an extension of the generalized Reed-Solomon (GRS) code, constitutes a well-studied calss of non-GRS codes.There are numerous works focusing on the Euclidean hull of (L,P)-TGRS codes, while only a few results on the Hermitian hull of (L,P)-TGRS codes. In this paper, we focus on a class of (L,P)-TGRS codes Cₖ₍ₐ₎. By taking a special class of the vector a with length i(q-1), and analyze the parity of i and the relation between i and q+1, we divide three cases to fully determine the Hermitian hull dimension of Cₖ₍ₐ₎. As an application, we construct two classes of entanglement-assisted quantum error-correcting codes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文致力于确定一类特殊的(L,P)-扭曲广义Reed-Solomon (TGRS) 码Cₖ₍ₐ₎的厄米特核维数。通过分析向量'a'的特殊选择以及'i'与'q+1'之间的关系，文章将问题分为三种情况，并完整地确定了Cₖ₍ₐ₎的厄米特核维数。作为应用，研究还构建了两类纠缠辅助量子纠错码。
authors: Chenlu Jia, Zhonghao Liang, Yue Huang, Qunying Liao

articles.title: Covert Communication Over a Quantum MAC with a Helper
articles.title_zh: 带有辅助者的量子多址信道上的隐蔽通信
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.18747v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study covert classical communication over a quantum multiple-access channel (MAC) with a helper. Specifically, we consider three transmitters, where one transmitter helps the other two transmitters communicate covertly with a receiver. We demonstrate the feasibility of achieving a positive covert rate over this channel and establish an achievable rate region. Our result recovers as a special case known results for classical communication over classical MACs with a degraded message set, classical communication over quantum MACs, and classical communication over MACs with a helper. To the best of our knowledge, our result is the first to achieve covert communication with positive rates over both classical and quantum MACs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在带有辅助者的量子多址信道（MAC）上进行隐蔽经典通信的问题。研究证明了在该信道上实现正隐蔽速率的可行性，并建立了一个可达速率区域。该结果涵盖了经典MAC、量子MAC以及带有辅助者的MAC的已知结果，并且是首次在经典和量子MAC上实现正隐蔽速率的通信。

articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.03569v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Existing literature provides several bounds for quantum local recovery, which essentially consider the number of message qudits, the distance, the length, and the locality of the involved codes. We give a family of J-affine variety codes that result in impure CSS codes. These quantum codes exceed several of the above mentioned bounds that apply to pure quantum locally recoverable codes. We also discuss a connection between bounds on quantum local recovery and on weight-constrained stabilizer codes.

articles.title: Quantum Voting Protocol for Centralized and Distributed Voting Based on Phase-Flip Counting
articles.title_zh: 基于相位翻转计数的集中式和分布式量子投票协议
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.15243v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce a quantum voting protocol that uses superposition and entanglement to enable secure, anonymous voting in both centralized and distributed settings. Votes are encoded via phase-flip operations on entangled candidate states, controlled by voter identity registers. Tallying is performed directly by measuring the candidate register, eliminating the need for iterative classical counting. The protocol is described for a centralized single-machine model and extended to a distributed quantum channel model with entanglement-based verification for enhanced security. Its efficiency relies on basic quantum gates (Hadamard and controlled-Z) and the ability to extract vote counts from quantum measurements. Practical validation is provided through analytical examples (4 voters with 2 candidates and 8 voters with 3 candidates) as well as numerical experiments that simulate ideal conditions, depolarizing noise, dishonest voter attacks, and sampling convergence. The results confirm exact probability preservation, robustness against errors, and statistical behavior consistent with theoretical bounds. The protocol ensures voter anonymity via superposition, formalized as the indistinguishability of tallying transcripts under vote permutations and reinforced by an identity-dephasing step that renders the identity register exactly maximally mixed, prevents double-voting through entanglement mechanisms, and offers favorable complexity for large-scale elections.

authors: Adrien Poindron and Stefan Willitsch

Rev. Research 8, 033031] Published Tue Jul 07, 2026

authors: Fabian Schindler and Jörg Schumacher

articles.title: Detection of quantum entanglement across the event horizon
articles.title_zh: 探测事件视界上的量子纠缠
articles.abstract: Author(s): Patryk Michalski and Andrzej Dragan We investigate the problem of distinguishing between separable and entangled states of two quantum wave packets, one of which falls into a black hole. Intuitively, one might expect the two scenarios to be indistinguishable, since the information carried by one wave packet is hidden beyond the event … [Phys. Rev. A 114, 012420] Published Tue Jul 07, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了区分两个量子波包的可分离态和纠缠态的问题，其中一个波包落入黑洞。直观上，人们可能认为这两种情况是无法区分的，因为一个波包所携带的信息隐藏在事件视界之外。然而，该工作探讨了在特定条件下探测事件视界上量子纠缠的可能性。
authors: Patryk Michalski and Andrzej Dragan

This degrades performance both by lowering operating speeds and increasing qubit storage time in noisy memories, making some quantum internet applications infeasible. One way to circumvent this bottleneck is multipl… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 012603] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 近期量子网络面临量子通信速率低的瓶颈，这降低了运行速度并增加了噪声存储器中量子比特的存储时间。为了解决这一问题，该工作探讨了利用量子策略来克服经典多路复用限制的方法。详情需查阅原文。
authors: Tzula B. Propp, Jeroen Grimbergen, Emil R. Hellebek, Junior R. Gonzales-Ureta, Janice van Dam, Joshua A. Slater, Anders S. Sørensen, and Stephanie D. C. Wehner

Yelin The authors propose a quantum metrology framework that harnesses the narrow linewidths of subradiant collective states in subwavelength emitter arrays. By introducing spatially varying control detunings to couple dark and bright modes, they show that the resulting sharp features in the transmission spectrum enable the precise detection of both global and local perturbations under realistic experimental imperfections. [Phys. Rev. A 114, 013704] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出了一种量子计量框架，利用亚波长发射器阵列中亚辐射集体态的窄线宽特性。通过引入空间变化的控制失谐来耦合暗模式和亮模式，研究表明透射光谱中产生的尖锐特征能够实现对全局和局部扰动的精确检测，即使在实际实验缺陷下也有效。
authors: Diego Zafra-Bono, Oriol Rubies-Bigorda, and Susanne F. Yelin

Analytically solving the master equation, we find that the system reaches a Gaussian steady state in the PT-symmetric regime. Quadrature squeezing a… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 013706] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了与热浴耦合的驱动非厄米斯旺森振子中的正交压缩和量子费希尔信息。通过解析求解主方程，发现系统在PT对称区域达到高斯稳态。该工作围绕系统的压缩特性和参数估计展开，详情需查阅原文。
authors: Jing-yang Li and Yaping Yang

articles.title: Consistent monitoring of quantum fluctuations
articles.title_zh: 量子涨落的一致性监测
articles.abstract: Author(s): Xiangyu Cao This Letter considers whether fluctuations of extensive quantities in many-body systems can be consistently monitored, namely, whether measurements can be performed without disturbing future outcome distribution. The answer turns out to be “no” in a large class of situations, and the amount of disturbance can be exactly calculated in terms of linear response quantities. [Phys. Rev. A 114, L010201] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇快报探讨了多体系统中广延量的涨落是否可以被一致地监测，即测量是否能在不干扰未来结果分布的情况下进行。研究发现，在很大一类情况下答案是否定的，并且干扰量可以用线性响应量精确计算。
authors: Xiangyu Cao

articles.title_zh: 学习费米子基态的最小表示

Research 8, 033014] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026

authors: Felix Frohnert, Emiel Koridon, and Stefano Polla

In order to address quantum… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033024] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用半经典层析成像的视角，分析了有限尺寸一维环形晶格和开放链中玻色-哈伯德凝聚体的亚稳态。该方法强调了多体谱与底层经典相空间结构之间的关系。
authors: Rajat and Doron Cohen

Sørensen Long-distance entanglement generation at a high rate is a major quantum technological goal yet to be fully realized, with the promise of many interesting applications, such as secure quantum computing on remote servers and quantum cryptography. One possible implementation is using a variant of the s… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033026] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 高速率长距离纠缠生成是量子技术的一个重要目标，有望应用于远程安全量子计算和量子密码学等领域。该工作研究了多模源对基于系综的量子中继器的影响，以期实现这一目标。详情需查阅原文。
authors: Emil R. Hellebek and Anders S. Sørensen

authors: Jun Zhang, Ya-Jun Wang, Shi-Yao Shao, Bang Liu, Li-Hua Zhang, Zheng-Yuan Zhang, Xin Liu, Chao Yu, Qing Li, Han-Chao Chen, Yu Ma, Tian-Yu Han, Qi-Feng Wang, Jia-Dou Nan, Yi-Ming Yin, Dong-Yang Zhu, Qiao-Qiao Fang, Dong-Sheng Ding, and Bao-Sen Shi

authors: Chenlu Li, Hui Zeng, and Dazhi Ding

authors: Dario Picozzi, Jonathan Tennyson, Vincent Graves, and Jimena D. Gorfinkiel

However, with recent advances in quantum control, it has become possible to use these modes directly as quantum computational resources. Here, we propose a dual-rail encoding… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 012408] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 囚禁离子的振动模式传统上被用作量子总线，以介导内部量子比特之间的纠缠。然而，随着量子控制的最新进展，现在可以直接将这些模式用作量子计算资源。本文提出了一种双轨编码方案，旨在有效倍增囚禁离子系统中的量子比特数量。
authors: Minhyeok Kang, Wentao Chen, Hyukjoon Kwon, Kihwan Kim, and Joonsuk Huh

For this form of nonlocality, a probabl… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 012410] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 近年来，对真正非局域性的研究日益增多，旨在探索在并非所有子系统都连接在一起的情况下，正交多体量子态中编码的全局信息的局部可访问性。对于这种形式的非局域性，该工作研究了具有最小基数的真正非局域集。
authors: Zong-Xing Xiong, Mao-Sheng Li, Bing Yu, Zhu-Jun Zheng, and Lvzhou Li

Although the standard Grover search cannot be further accelerated in the full… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 012412] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: Grover算法为非结构化数据库搜索提供了相对于经典算法的二次加速，并且在谕示查询复杂度方面被认为是严格最优的。尽管标准Grover搜索在完全搜索中无法进一步加速，但本文研究了量子部分搜索算法的渐近界。该工作还探讨了其在并行搜索中的潜在应用。
authors: Yan-Bo Jiang, Xiao-Hui Wang, Kun Zhang, and Vladimir Korepin

An approach to alleviating these demands is provided by adaptiv… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 012414] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026

authors: Adrian Skasberg Aasen and Martin Gärttner

Starting from the full system-bath Hamiltonian with Lorentzian coupling distributions, we analytically obtain a time-local ma… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 012415] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过微观方法推导了在局域退相干噪声下，在空间分离模式之间隧穿的两分量玻色子（玻色子量子比特）的主方程。从具有洛伦兹耦合分布的完整系统-浴哈密顿量出发，研究人员解析地得到了一个时间局域的主方程。这项工作为理解玻色子量子比特在噪声环境中的动力学提供了理论基础。
authors: Alberto Ferrara, Farzam Nosrati, Andrea Smirne, Jyrki Piilo, and Rosario Lo Franco

The authors study the relaxation of systems whose effective dynamics are described by Davies maps, providing a framework to engineer the quantum Mpemba effect in Markovian open quantum systems. [Phys. Rev. A 114, 012418] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 姆潘巴效应是指一个系统初始时离平衡态越远，弛豫速度反而越快。本文研究了由戴维斯映射描述其有效动力学的系统的弛豫过程。该工作提供了一个在马尔可夫开放量子系统中设计量子姆潘巴效应的框架，并探讨了指数加速弛豫现象。
authors: Emerson Lima Caldas and Diego Paiva Pires

articles.title_zh: 量子密钥分发中探测器的能量-时间攻击

authors: Konstantin Zaitsev, Vladimir Bizin, Dmitriy Kuzmin, and Vadim Makarov

authors: Sewon Jeong, Shrobona Bagchi, Jaehak Lee, Hyang-Tag Lim, Yong-Su Kim, Taeyoung Choi, and Seung-Woo Lee

articles.title: Mitigating noise effects in phase estimation via a quantum cyclic n-switch
articles.title_zh: 通过量子循环n开关减轻相位估计中的噪声效应
articles.abstract: Author(s): Zhen-Dong Wei, Wei-Bin Yan, Zhong-Xiao Man, Yun-Jie Xia, Ying-Jie Zhang, and Qing-Yu Cai In this work we investigate phase estimation of a two-qubit system under the action of the quantum cyclic n-switch in generalized amplitude-damping, depolarizing, and phase-damping channels. Our results show that the quantum cyclic n-switch can improve the precision of phase estimation in correl… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 012604] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在广义振幅阻尼、去极化和相位阻尼信道中，量子循环n开关作用下双量子比特系统的相位估计。研究结果表明，量子循环n开关可以提高相关噪声环境中相位估计的精度。
authors: Zhen-Dong Wei, Wei-Bin Yan, Zhong-Xiao Man, Yun-Jie Xia, Ying-Jie Zhang, and Qing-Yu Cai

articles.title: Distributed quantum dense coding enhanced with nonclassical routing
articles.title_zh: 增强非经典路由的分布式量子密集编码
articles.abstract: Author(s): Pratham Hullamballi, Aparajita Bhattacharyya, and Ujjwal Sen We propose a distributed quantum dense coding protocol that uses a control system to superpose two dense coding processes, allowing us to simultaneously and coherently encode and nonclassically route the sender's single-qubit system to two receiver laboratories. We find that dense coding with cohere… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 012605] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出了一种分布式量子密集编码协议，利用控制系统叠加两个密集编码过程。这使得发送者的单量子比特系统能够同时、相干地编码并以非经典方式路由到两个接收实验室。研究发现，通过相干叠加实现的密集编码具有显著优势。
authors: Pratham Hullamballi, Aparajita Bhattacharyya, and Ujjwal Sen

articles.title: Probing short-range gravity using quantum reflection
articles.title_zh: 利用量子反射探测短程引力
articles.abstract: Author(s): J. Boynewicz and C. A. Sackett Quantum reflection occurs when ultracold atoms are incident on a material surface with sufficiently low velocity. The reflecting matter wave can interfere with the incident wave to form a detectable pattern, and this pattern contains information about atom-surface interactions at micrometer scales. … [Phys. Rev. A 114, 013301] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 当超冷原子以足够低的速度入射到材料表面时，会发生量子反射现象。反射的物质波可以与入射波干涉形成可探测的图案，该图案包含了微米尺度上原子-表面相互作用的信息。该研究利用这一现象来探测短程引力。
authors: J. Boynewicz and C. A. Sackett

articles.title: Three-dimensional squeezing of optically levitated nanospheres
articles.title_zh: 光学悬浮纳米球的三维压缩
articles.abstract: Author(s): Giacomo Marocco, David C. Moore, and Daniel Carney We propose a protocol to measure three-dimensional impulses beyond the standard quantum limit. The protocol reduces noise in all three spatial dimensions and consists of squeezing a mechanical system's state via a series of jumps in the frequency of the harmonic potential. We quantify how decoherenc… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 013504] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种测量超越标准量子极限的三维脉冲的协议。该协议通过一系列谐波势频率的跳变来压缩机械系统的状态，从而降低所有三个空间维度的噪声。研究还量化了退相干对该协议性能的影响。
authors: Giacomo Marocco, David C. Moore, and Daniel Carney

articles.title: Phase-labeled truncated state for quantum nondemolition measurement
articles.title_zh: 用于量子无损测量的相位标记截断态
articles.abstract: Author(s): Hassan Sobhani This paper demonstrates a scheme that combines a linear quantum scissor (LQS) with weak cross-Kerr nonlinearity (CKN) to perform quantum nondemolition (QND) measurements. Performing the postselection on an input coherent state in the LQS, a superposition of vacuum and a single-photon component is tr… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 013703] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一种结合线性量子剪刀（LQS）和弱交叉克尔非线性（CKN）以实现量子无损（QND）测量的方案。通过对LQS中输入相干态进行后选择，可以制备出真空态和单光子态的叠加态，该方案为高精度量子测量提供了新的途径。
authors: Hassan Sobhani

articles.title: Learning complexity gradually in quantum machine learning models
articles.title_zh: 量子机器学习模型中逐步学习复杂性
articles.abstract: Author(s): Erik Recio-Armengol, Franz J. Schreiber, Jens Eisert, and Carlos Bravo-Prieto Quantum machine learning is an emergent field that continues to draw significant interest for its potential to offer improvements over classical algorithms in certain areas. However, training quantum models remains a challenging task, largely because of the difficulty in establishing an effective in… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033006] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 量子机器学习是一个新兴领域，因其在某些方面超越经典算法的潜力而备受关注。然而，训练量子模型仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，主要原因在于难以建立有效的初始化策略。该研究探讨了在量子机器学习模型中逐步学习复杂性的方法。
authors: Erik Recio-Armengol, Franz J. Schreiber, Jens Eisert, and Carlos Bravo-Prieto

articles.title: Variational matrix product states for combinatorial optimization
articles.title_zh: 用于组合优化的变分矩阵乘积态
articles.abstract: Author(s): Guillermo Preisser, Conor Mc Keever, and Michael Lubasch To compute approximate solutions for combinatorial optimization problems, we describe variational methods based on the product state (PS) and matrix product state (MPS) ansätze. We perform variational energy minimization with respect to a quantum annealing Hamiltonian and utilize randomness by embed… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033027] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 为了计算组合优化问题的近似解，本文描述了基于乘积态（PS）和矩阵乘积态（MPS）拟设的变分方法。研究通过对量子退火哈密顿量进行变分能量最小化，并利用随机性来嵌入问题，以期找到高效的解决方案。
authors: Guillermo Preisser, Conor Mc Keever, and Michael Lubasch

articles.title: Intrinsic Preservation of Plasticity in Continual Quantum Learning
articles.title_zh: 持续量子学习中可塑性的内在保持
articles.abstract: Author(s): Yu-Qin Chen and Shi-Xin Zhang Unlike classical neural networks, quantum neural networks retain flexibility even as internal parameters grow, potentially providing long-term learning capabilities. [PRX Quantum 7, 033003] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 与经典神经网络不同，量子神经网络即使在内部参数增长的情况下也能保持灵活性。这可能为其提供长期的学习能力，为持续学习领域带来了新的视角。
authors: Yu-Qin Chen and Shi-Xin Zhang

articles.title: Robust Certification of Non-Projective Measurements: Theory and Experiment
articles.title_zh: 非投影测量的鲁棒认证：理论与实验
articles.abstract: Author(s): Raphael Brinster, Peter Tirler, Shishir Khandelwal, Michael Meth, Hermann Kampermann, Dagmar Bruß, Rainer Blatt, Martin Ringbauer, Armin Tavakoli, and Nikolai Wyderka A new complete semidefinite programming hierarchy is used to certify the impossibility of simulating quantum measurements by projective ones, accompanied by an experimental demonstration on a trapped-ion platform. [PRX Quantum 7, 033005] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用一种新的完整半定规划层次结构，来认证通过投影测量模拟量子测量的不可行性。该理论伴随着在囚禁离子平台上进行的实验演示，为非投影测量的可靠性提供了强有力的证据。
authors: Raphael Brinster, Peter Tirler, Shishir Khandelwal, Michael Meth, Hermann Kampermann, Dagmar Bruß, Rainer Blatt, Martin Ringbauer, Armin Tavakoli, and Nikolai Wyderka

articles.title: Physically motivated decompositions of single-qutrit gates
articles.title_zh: 单量子三态门（qutrit gate）的物理驱动分解
articles.abstract: Author(s): Aryan Iliat, Mark Byrd, Sahel Ashhab, and Lian-Ao Wu Although only two quantum states of a physical system are often used to encode quantum information into qubits, in principle, qudits (a system with a number d states) could be used to increase the information capacity of the system. In this work, three-state systems (qutrits) are studied using a p… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 012606] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管通常只使用物理系统的两个量子态来编码量子信息为量子比特，但原则上，量子d态系统（qudits）可以增加系统的信息容量。本文研究了三态系统（量子三态，qutrits），并提出了一种基于物理动机的单量子三态门分解方法。这项工作对于开发更高效的量子计算方案具有重要意义。
authors: Aryan Iliat, Mark Byrd, Sahel Ashhab, and Lian-Ao Wu

articles.title: High winding number in rhombohedrally stacked Su-Schrieffer-Heeger multilayers
articles.title_zh: 菱面体堆叠Su-Schrieffer-Heeger多层结构中的高缠绕数
articles.abstract: Author(s): Feng Lu, Ao Zhou, Shujie Cheng, and Gao Xianlong We study the topological properties of rhombohedrally stacked N-layer Su-Schrieffer-Heeger networks with interlayer coupling. We find that these systems exhibit 2N-fold degenerate zero-energy edge states with winding number W=N, providing a direct route to high winding number topological phase… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 024203] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有层间耦合的菱面体堆叠N层Su-Schrieffer-Heeger网络的拓扑性质。研究发现这些系统表现出2N重简并的零能边缘态，其缠绕数W=N。这为实现高缠绕数拓扑相提供了一条直接途径，对于拓扑材料的研究具有重要意义。
authors: Feng Lu, Ao Zhou, Shujie Cheng, and Gao Xianlong

articles.title: Synthesis, physical properties, and band structure of antiferromagnetic Cr₂Se₃
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁Cr₂Se₃的合成、物理性质和能带结构
articles.abstract: Author(s): Xiaoqing Qian, Wenhao Shen, Shouli Zhou, Zixin Cui, Zize Zheng, Wei Wei, Yingying Gao, Bin Li, Xiaofeng Xu, Wei Zhou, and Chunqiang Xu Owing to the unique coupling effect between spin and topological order, antiferromagnetic topological materials hold significant application prospects in the fields of low-power spintronic devices and quantum computing, emerging as a research focus in the field of condensed matter physics. In this w… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 024404] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 反铁磁拓扑材料因其自旋与拓扑序之间独特的耦合效应，在低功耗自旋电子器件和量子计算领域具有重要的应用前景。本文研究了反铁磁Cr₂Se₃的合成、物理性质和能带结构。该工作有助于深入理解这类材料的特性，并推动其在凝聚态物理领域的应用。
authors: Xiaoqing Qian, Wenhao Shen, Shouli Zhou, Zixin Cui, Zize Zheng, Wei Wei, Yingying Gao, Bin Li, Xiaofeng Xu, Wei Zhou, and Chunqiang Xu

articles.title: Eigenstate thermalization and spectral imprints of many-body systems in projected local observables
articles.title_zh: 本征态热化与多体系统在投影局域可观测量中的谱印记
articles.abstract: Author(s): Shivam Mishra, C Jisha, and Ravi Prakash The Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis explains thermalization in isolated quantum systems through the statistical properties of observables in the energy eigenbasis. We study the crossover from integrability-to-chaos in the spin-1/2 XXZ chain by introducing a local perturbation. Using exact dia… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 034202] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究通过引入局域微扰，探讨了自旋-1/2 XXZ链中从可积性到混沌的转变。该工作基于本征态热化假说，该假说通过能量本征基中可观测量的统计特性解释了孤立量子系统中的热化现象。利用精确对角化方法，本文深入分析了多体系统在投影局域可观测量中的谱特征，揭示了其在热化过程中的作用。
authors: Shivam Mishra, C Jisha, and Ravi Prakash

articles.title: Many-body non-Hermitian quasiperiodic systems with power-law hopping: Localization, topology, and the skin effect
articles.title_zh: 具有幂律跳跃的多体非厄米准周期系统：局域化、拓扑与趋肤效应
articles.abstract: Author(s): Aditi Chakrabarty, Sanchayan Banerjee, Tapan Mishra, and Sanjoy Datta In this work, we study one-dimensional interacting non-Hermitian quasiperiodic lattices with asymmetric power-law hopping in the presence of time-reversal symmetry (TRS). In contrast to earlier works on short-range non-Hermitian quasiperiodic models with TRS, both with and without interactions, wher… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 034204] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一维相互作用的非厄米准周期晶格，其具有不对称幂律跳跃并存在时间反演对称性。与之前短程非厄米准周期模型的工作不同，本研究深入探讨了长程跳跃对系统局域化、拓扑性质以及趋肤效应的影响。该工作揭示了此类系统中独特的物理现象和潜在应用。
authors: Aditi Chakrabarty, Sanchayan Banerjee, Tapan Mishra, and Sanjoy Datta

articles.title: Tailoring dynamical quantum phase transitions via double-mode squeezing manipulation
articles.title_zh: 通过双模压缩操控定制动力学量子相变
articles.abstract: Author(s): Kaiyuan Cao, Haodong Wang, Xiang-Ping Jiang, Shu Chen, and Jian Wang We propose a protocol to tailor dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) by double-mode squeezing onto the initial state in the XY chain. The effect of squeezing depends critically on the system's symmetry and parameters. When the squeezing operator breaks particle-hole symmetry (PHS),… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 034301] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种通过对XY链初始态进行双模压缩来定制动力学量子相变（DQPTs）的方案。研究发现，压缩效应关键取决于系统的对称性和参数。当压缩算符破坏粒子-空穴对称性时，可以显著影响DQPTs的发生和特性，为调控量子相变提供了新途径。
authors: Kaiyuan Cao, Haodong Wang, Xiang-Ping Jiang, Shu Chen, and Jian Wang

articles.title: Manifestation of asymmetric manganite-ruthenate interfaces
articles.title_zh: 非对称锰酸盐-钌酸盐界面的表现
articles.abstract: Author(s): Haoming Ling, Xin Du, Zhixiong Deng, Kai Hu, Qiangtao Sui, Zixin Fan, Lingyuan Kong, Dingyi Li, Shaojie Tai, Wei Li, Yan Liang, Pan Chen, Kai Liu, Zhaoliang Liao, Meng Meng, Xiaoran Liu, Zhen Wang, and Jiandi Zhang Interfacial magnetism in complex oxide heterostructures underlies both fundamental many-body physics and advanced spintronic applications. Here we report a pronounced stacking-order dependence of magnetic coupling in La₀.₇₈Ca₀.₂₂MnO₃/mathrm{… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 034409] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 复杂氧化物异质结构中的界面磁性是基础多体物理和先进自旋电子学应用的关键。本研究报告了在La₀.₇₈Ca₀.₂₂MnO₃/SrRuO₃异质结构中，磁耦合对堆叠顺序的显著依赖性。该发现揭示了界面不对称性对材料磁学性质的重要影响，为设计新型自旋电子器件提供了指导。
authors: Haoming Ling, Xin Du, Zhixiong Deng, Kai Hu, Qiangtao Sui, Zixin Fan, Lingyuan Kong, Dingyi Li, Shaojie Tai, Wei Li, Yan Liang, Pan Chen, Kai Liu, Zhaoliang Liao, Meng Meng, Xiaoran Liu, Zhen Wang, and Jiandi Zhang

articles.title: Weak second-order topological insulators hidden in trivial symmetry indicators: A reconfigurable spin splitter
articles.title_zh: 隐藏在平凡对称性指标中的弱二阶拓扑绝缘体：一种可重构的自旋分离器
articles.abstract: Author(s): Zihao He and Xiang Ni The discovery of higher-order topological phases hosting boundary modes at hinges or corners has revolutionized our understanding of quantum materials. While axion insulators (AXIs) characterized by symmetry indicator Z₄=2 are known to host chiral hinge states, the topological landsc… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 045106] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 高阶拓扑相的发现彻底改变了我们对量子材料的理解。本研究揭示了隐藏在平凡对称性指标中的弱二阶拓扑绝缘体，其拓扑景观远超轴子绝缘体。该工作提出此类材料可作为一种可重构的自旋分离器，为拓扑量子器件的设计提供了新思路。
authors: Zihao He and Xiang Ni

articles.title: Topological phase transitions in strained Lieb-kagome lattices
articles.title_zh: 应变Lieb-kagome晶格中的拓扑相变
articles.abstract: Author(s): W. P. Lima, T. F. O. Lara, J. P. G. Nascimento, J. Milton Pereira, Jr., and D. R. da Costa Lieb and kagome lattices exhibit two-dimensional topological insulator behavior with Z₂ topological classification when considering spin-orbit coupling. In this study, we used a general tight-binding Hamiltonian with a morphological control parameter θ to describe the Lieb (θ=π/2… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 045402] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: Lieb和kagome晶格在考虑自旋轨道耦合时表现出具有Z₂拓扑分类的二维拓扑绝缘体行为。本研究使用一个包含形态控制参数θ的通用紧束缚哈密顿量来描述这些晶格。通过施加应变，我们探讨了这些晶格中发生的拓扑相变，揭示了应变对拓扑性质的调控作用。
authors: W. P. Lima, T. F. O. Lara, J. P. G. Nascimento, J. Milton Pereira, Jr., and D. R. da Costa

articles.title: Topological phase transition and nonlinear anomalous Hall effects in strained gapped graphene under polarized light
articles.title_zh: 偏振光下应变带隙石墨烯中的拓扑相变和非线性反常霍尔效应
articles.abstract: Author(s): Zi-Jie Wang, Hong-Yu Chen, Guo-Bao Zhu, An-Chun Ji, and Qing Sun We investigate the topological and nonlinear transport properties of uniaxially strained gapped graphene driven by polarized optical fields. We demonstrate that the interplay between optical polarization and lattice strain fundamentally reshapes the Berry curvature distribution, leading to a valley-… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 045403] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在偏振光场驱动下，单轴应变带隙石墨烯的拓扑和非线性输运性质。研究表明，光学偏振和晶格应变之间的相互作用从根本上重塑了贝里曲率分布。这种重塑导致了谷极化和非线性反常霍尔效应的出现，为光电调控石墨烯的拓扑特性提供了新途径。
authors: Zi-Jie Wang, Hong-Yu Chen, Guo-Bao Zhu, An-Chun Ji, and Qing Sun

articles.title: Proliferation transitions from a topological phase in 2+1 dimensions
articles.title_zh: 2+1维拓扑相中的增殖相变
articles.abstract: Author(s): Meng Cheng and Nathan Seiberg We consider phase transitions out of a general topological phase in 2+1 dimensions. We assume that the transition is triggered by a single Abelian anyon, which becomes light near the transition and whose worldlines proliferate after the transition. (This proliferation is often referred to as “cond… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 055103] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2+1维中从一般拓扑相出发的相变。我们假设相变是由单个阿贝尔任意子触发的，该任意子在相变附近变得轻盈，并且其世界线在相变后增殖。这种增殖通常被称为“凝聚”，该工作深入探讨了这种机制如何导致拓扑相的转变和新相的形成。
authors: Meng Cheng and Nathan Seiberg

articles.title: Entanglement spectrum of gapless topological phases: A case study with topological superconductors
articles.title_zh: 无能隙拓扑相的纠缠谱：以拓扑超导体为例
articles.abstract: Author(s): Archi Banerjee and Meng Zeng Using bulk gapless topological superconductors in both 1D and 2D as free fermion model examples, we demonstrate the power of subsystem correlation spectrum (the spectrum of correlation matrix), or equivalently the entanglement spectrum for the case of free fermions, in characterizing the topology of… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 055104] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文以一维和二维体无能隙拓扑超导体作为自由费米子模型示例，展示了子系统关联谱（即关联矩阵的谱）在表征拓扑性质方面的强大能力。对于自由费米子情况，这等同于纠缠谱。该研究强调了纠缠谱作为识别和分类无能隙拓扑相的有效工具，为拓扑物理研究提供了新方法。
authors: Archi Banerjee and Meng Zeng

articles.title: Hydrodynamic edge modes and fragile surface states of symmetry-protected integer quantum Hall effect of bosons
articles.title_zh: 玻色子对称保护整数量子霍尔效应的流体动力学边缘模式和脆弱表面态
articles.abstract: Author(s): Dylan Reynolds, Gustavo M. Monteiro, and Sriram Ganeshan We adapt the fluid description of fractional quantum Hall states, as seen in Monteiro et al . [ Phys. Rev. B 109 , 174525 (2024) ], to model a system of interacting two-component bosons. This system represents the simplest physical realization of an interacting bosonic symmetry-protected topological (SP… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 055106] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将分数量子霍尔态的流体描述方法应用于建模相互作用的两分量玻色子系统。该系统代表了相互作用玻色子对称保护拓扑（SPT）相的最简单物理实现。研究探讨了此类系统中的流体动力学边缘模式和脆弱表面态，为理解玻色子SPT相的边界物理提供了新的见解。
authors: Dylan Reynolds, Gustavo M. Monteiro, and Sriram Ganeshan

articles.title: Topologically nontrivial multicritical points
articles.title_zh: 拓扑非平庸多临界点
articles.abstract: Author(s): Ranjith R. Kumar and Pasquale Marra Recently, the intriguing interplay between topology and quantum criticality has been unveiled in one-dimensional topological chains with extended nearest-neighbor couplings. In these systems, topologically distinct critical phases emerge with localized edge modes despite the vanishing bulk gap. In t… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 065404] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 近期研究揭示了拓扑与量子临界性在一维拓扑链中引人入胜的相互作用。在这些系统中，尽管体能隙消失，但仍会出现具有局域边缘模的拓扑不同临界相。本文将进一步探讨拓扑非平庸多临界点的特性，以期深入理解其物理机制。
authors: Ranjith R. Kumar and Pasquale Marra

articles.title: Error threshold of Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev models from strong-to-weak parity symmetry breaking
articles.title_zh: Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev模型从强到弱宇称对称性破缺的误差阈值

articles.title: Dynamics of photoexcited exciton-phonon systems: Time-dependent theoretical approaches
articles.title_zh: 光激发激子-声子系统的动力学：时间依赖的理论方法
articles.abstract: Author(s): Darius Abramavicius, Arunjyoti Baidya, Vytautas Bubilaitis, and Leonas Valkunas When molecular aggregates absorb light, the resulting exciton is shaped by a local phonon bath, which causes fluctuation, dephasing, and can eventually trap the excitation. This exciton-phonon coupling leads to exciton-polaron formation, transforming the coherent excitonic motion into the incoherent polaronic behavior. Here, the authors compare complementary time-dependent descriptions of this process. In the Heisenberg representation, the mean-field approximation treats phonons as classical fluctuating fields, while the one-quantum approximation retains one-phonon-assisted correlations and captures phonon sidebands in optical spectra. In parallel, a time-dependent variational polaron approach follows relaxation and self-trapping in the excited-state manifold. Together, these methods clarify how excitons evolve, decohere, and become coupled to vibrations. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 019602] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 当分子聚集体吸收光时，产生的激子受局部声子浴的影响，导致涨落、退相干并最终可能捕获激发。这种激子-声子耦合导致激子-极化子形成，将相干激子运动转变为非相干极化子行为。本文比较了描述这一过程的互补时间依赖理论方法，共同阐明了激子如何演化、退相干并与振动耦合。
authors: Darius Abramavicius, Arunjyoti Baidya, Vytautas Bubilaitis, and Leonas Valkunas

articles.abstract: Author(s): Wenhan Guo, Zheng Zhou (周正), Tzu-Chieh Wei, and Yin-Chen He The fuzzy-sphere regularization has emerged as a powerful route to three-dimensional conformal field theories (CFTs). Here, the authors extend it to the O ( N ) vector model, a cornerstone of many critical phenomena, constructing microscopic models for both the O ( N ) Wilson-Fisher and free-scalar CFTs at general N for fuzzy-sphere numerical calculations. Benchmarked for N = 2 , 3 , 4 against conformal bootstrap and Monte Carlo, the approach yields consistent results and grants direct access to operator spectra, including higher-spin and pseudoscalar operators that may be hard to reach by other methods. It also uncovers an unexpected feature: the fuzzy-sphere ground-state wave functions have large overlap with the trivial product state and small entanglement. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 065102] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026

articles.title: Logarithmic negativity typically equals exact entanglement cost
articles.title_zh: 对数负性通常等于精确纠缠成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01320v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum entanglement plays a leading role in modern understanding of physical systems, from quantum phases of matter to quantum gravity. In quantum information theory, one seeks operationally meaningful quantifiers of entanglement, which for large quantum systems are notoriously difficult to evaluate due to the lack of computationally efficient algorithms. In this Letter, we show that for large random induced mixed states the logarithmic negativity, an efficiently computable entanglement measure, generically coincides with the exact entanglement cost under positive-partial-transpose-preserving operations, thereby acquiring a precise operational interpretation. Our results establish logarithmic negativity as an exact characterization of entanglement in generic many-body states and provide a tractable route for quantifying entanglement in complex quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠缠在物理系统理解中扮演重要角色，但其量化对于大型量子系统计算困难。本研究表明，对于大型随机诱导混合态，对数负性（一种可有效计算的纠缠度量）通常与正部分转置保持操作下的精确纠缠成本一致，从而获得了精确的操作性解释。这些结果确立了对数负性作为通用多体态纠缠的精确表征，并为复杂量子系统中的纠缠量化提供了一条可行途径。
authors: Bowen Ouyang, Jonah Kudler-Flam

articles.title: Noisy quantum circuit simulation with the tensor jump method
articles.title_zh: 基于张量跳跃法的含噪声量子电路模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01323v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical simulation of noisy quantum circuits is essential for validating algorithms, benchmarking hardware, and assessing error-mitigation strategies, but remains limited by the exponential cost of density-matrix methods and the high variance of standard trajectory sampling. We introduce a variance-aware tensor network framework that combines the tensor jump method with local TDVP gate evolution on matrix product states and sparse Pauli-Lindblad hardware noise models. Gates are applied as short variational evolutions on the MPS manifold, while noise is sampled per circuit window from Pauli-Lindblad jump sets with state-independent hazards and dissipative contractions that reduce to irrelevant global factors after renormalization. The method supports correlated multi-qubit Lindblad noise consistent with hardware connectivity, including long-range operators on non-adjacent qubits, enabling direct simulation of crosstalk and other connectivity-induced errors beyond local noise models. We develop two unbiased variance-aware unravelings. An analog unitary-mixture unraveling matches the Lindblad generator exactly under symmetric Gaussian or two-point angle laws, while a projector-jump unraveling yields state-independent hazards and closed-form variance laws. Both retain the standard 1/sqrt(N) Monte Carlo convergence but with reduced prefactors. Empirically, projector sampling strongly reduces trajectory variance and bond-dimension growth across many circuit architectures, whereas analog sampling is most effective at weak noise. We demonstrate accurate, scalable noisy-circuit simulation on a 25-qubit noisy XY quench and IBM's 127-qubit kicked-Ising benchmark with long-range depolarizing noise, achieving reduced Monte Carlo variance and favorable MPS bond-dimension growth compared with standard Kraus-insertion baselines.
articles.abstract_zh: 含噪声量子电路的经典模拟对于算法验证和硬件基准测试至关重要，但受限于密度矩阵方法的指数成本和轨迹采样的高方差。本文引入了一种方差感知的张量网络框架，将张量跳跃法与矩阵乘积态上的局部TDVP门演化及稀疏Pauli-Lindblad硬件噪声模型相结合。该方法支持与硬件连接性一致的关联多量子比特Lindblad噪声，包括非相邻量子比特上的长程算符，从而能够直接模拟串扰和其他连接引起的误差。研究还开发了两种无偏的方差感知展开方法。
authors: Maximilian Fröhlich, Aaron Sander, Martin Eigel, Robert Wille, Michael Hintermüller

articles.title: One-Body Purity, Non-Gaussianity, and Entanglement in Interacting Integrable Models
articles.title_zh: 相互作用可积模型中的单体纯度、非高斯性和纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01326v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When describing entanglement in typical midspectrum eigenstates of many-body lattice Hamiltonians, two paradigms have emerged that capture the behavior observed in integrable and nonintegrable systems, Haar-random fermionic Gaussian states and Haar-random pure states, respectively. Remarkably, the former capture the behavior of interacting integrable systems, whose eigenstates are non-Gaussian. We argue that the paradigm that captures both the entanglement properties and the lack of Gaussianity in integrable systems is that of random superpositions of polynomially many Gaussian states. In contrast, eigenstates of nonintegrable systems are consistent with being described by random superpositions of exponentially many Gaussian states. We gain this understanding by comparing analytical and numerical results for the one-body purity, the non-Gaussianity, and the entanglement entropy of the random superpositions and the Hamiltonian eigenstates.
articles.abstract_zh: 在描述多体晶格哈密顿量中态的纠缠时，可积和不可积系统分别由Haar随机费米高斯态和Haar随机纯态捕获。本文提出，能够同时捕获可积系统中纠缠特性和非高斯性的范式是多项式数量高斯态的随机叠加。相比之下，不可积系统的本征态则与指数数量高斯态的随机叠加描述一致。这一理解是通过比较随机叠加和哈密顿量本征态的单体纯度、非高斯性和纠缠熵的分析和数值结果获得的。
authors: Rafał Świketek, Maksymilian Kliczkowski, Lev Vidmar, Marcos Rigol

articles.title: Ravines in quantum cost landscapes: opportunities for improved VQA predictions
articles.title_zh: 量子成本景观中的“峡谷”：改进VQA预测的机遇
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01329v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The geometric and topological structure of quantum cost landscapes (QCLs) governs the optimization and thus the predictive power of variational quantum algorithms (VQAs). We systematically analyze ravines - low-cost paths connecting local minima - using an adapted version of the nudged elastic band (NEB) algorithm, a method originating from theoretical chemistry. By training quantum neural networks (QNNs) to classify the concentratable entanglement of quantum states, we apply the NEB algorithm and numerically identify ravine structures in QCLs of hardware-efficient ansatzes. Beyond visualizing these ravines, we construct an ensemble prediction framework by averaging predictions from QNNs parameterized along the low-cost NEB path. We introduce a resource-light pre-training metric which quantifies local-prediction variability and serves as a strong performance indicator for VQAs, even beyond the scope of this study. When base classifiers are drawn from circuit and weight initializations exhibiting high local-prediction variability, the quantum-based NEB ensembles outperform both classical and naive quantum alternatives. Moreover, a complexity analysis shows that leveraging the ravine-like structure of QCLs with the QNN NEB approach substantially reduces computational costs compared to naive QNN ensembling. A depth and qubit scaling analysis indicates that ravines persist across both scalings, and that, despite the expected growth in resource requirements with the qubit scaling, the NEB approach also accelerates convergence over the naive alternative.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子成本景观（QCLs）的几何和拓扑结构决定了变分量子算法（VQAs）的优化和预测能力。本文利用修正的“微扰弹性带”（NEB）算法系统分析了QCLs中的“峡谷”（连接局部最小值的低成本路径）。通过训练量子神经网络（QNNs）对量子态的可集中纠缠进行分类，研究识别了硬件高效拟设QCLs中的峡谷结构。此外，通过沿低成本NEB路径参数化的QNNs预测进行平均，构建了一个集成预测框架，并引入了一种轻量级预训练指标来量化局部预测变异性。
authors: Felix J. Beckmann, João F. Bravo

articles.title: Decoupling band topology from criticality in bosonic systems
articles.title_zh: 玻色子系统中能带拓扑与临界性的解耦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01334v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A new understanding of criticality in systems described by quadratic bosonic Hamiltonians (QBHs) ties the emergence of long-range correlations to boundaries of dynamical, not thermodynamical, stability in the parameter space. This separation occurs because the solution of the Heisenberg equations of motion is determined by an auxiliary pseudo- Hermitian dynamical system. The boundary points of a region of dynamical stability can be either exceptional points, generically associated with long-range correlations, or Krein collisions, where correlations can be either long- or short-range. We investigate the interplay of this landscape of possibilities with band topology and boundary physics, by relying on both specific examples and general arguments. The examples stem from a two-parameter, thermodynamically unstable family of QBHs obtained from the bosonic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model by breaking particle conservation while preserving a chiral pseudo-symmetry. The dynamically stable regime breaks up into different regions labeled by an integer-valued symplectic analogue of the Berry phase. The topological phase transition is a line of Krein collisions, which coincides with the closing of a band gap at zero and causes the localization length of the topologically mandated boundary zero modes to diverge before disappearing. In the unstable regime, we show that the chiral pseudo-symmetry of our model induces, despite the broken particle-number symmetry, enough structure on its associated dynamical matrices to support a topological classification and a bulk-boundary correspondence, independently of dynamical stability. This strongly suggests that bosonic topological physics extracted from basic index theory is insensitive to dynamical stability and, a posteriori, to non-interacting criticality.
articles.abstract_zh: 玻色子哈密顿量（QBHs）描述的系统中，临界性的新理解将长程关联的出现与参数空间中动力学稳定性而非热力学稳定性的边界联系起来。本文通过具体示例和一般论证，研究了这种可能性与能带拓扑和边界物理的相互作用。研究发现，动力学稳定区域被划分为由贝里相的整数值辛模拟标记的不同区域，拓扑相变表现为Krein碰撞线。
authors: Mariam Ughrelidze, Lorenza Viola, Emilio Cobanera

articles.title: Quantum Trajectory Entanglement in Seeded Boundary Time Crystals
articles.title_zh: 边界时间晶体播种过程中的量子轨迹纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01335v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the entanglement dynamics along quantum trajectories during the seeding of time-crystalline order in a boundary time crystal (BTC). Specifically, how entanglement spreads among different spin ensembles when a BTC attempts to seed its time-crystalline behavior onto otherwise static spin ensembles, through a collective dissipative channel. We analyse both the dynamical growth of entanglement in time and the steady-state properties of the system. Our results reveal two fundamentally distinct regimes. In the seeded BTC phase, the steady-state entanglement entropy between the ensembles grows with system size N, accompanied by macroscopic fluctuations along the trajectories. In contrast, in the non-seeded static phase, both the steady-state entanglement and its fluctuations decay exponentially with N. The model thus features a measurement-induced phase transition (MIPT) driven by the seeding mechanism. Furthermore, these findings establish dissipative seeding as a powerful mechanism for controlling quantum correlations in open many-body systems, with direct experimental relevance to this class of model without a postselection barrier.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了边界时间晶体（BTC）中时间晶体序播种过程中，沿量子轨迹的纠缠动力学。研究分析了纠缠随时间的动态增长和系统的稳态特性，揭示了两种根本不同的机制。在播种的BTC相中，稳态纠缠熵随系统尺寸N增长，并伴随宏观涨落；而在未播种的静态相中，稳态纠缠及其涨落随N呈指数衰减。该模型展示了由播种机制驱动的测量诱导相变，并确立了耗散播种作为控制开放多体系统中量子关联的强大机制。
authors: Mohammad Jafari, Fernando Iemini

articles.title: Mechanistic Interpretability and Causal Feature Steering of Neural Quantum States via Sparse Autoencoders
articles.title_zh: 基于稀疏自编码器的神经量子态的机制可解释性与因果特征引导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01336v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural Quantum States (NQS) are a remarkably expressive class of variational ansätze for quantum many-body wavefunctions, yet little is understood about their internal mechanisms: trained on variational objectives alone, how do NQS accurately capture physical observables that they have never been explicitly optimized for? In this work, we present a systematic approach to analyze the internal activations of NQS using sparse autoencoders. We extract features from the residual stream and demonstrate that these features strongly correlate with physical observables such as order parameters, staggered magnetization, and half-chain correlators, across both ground state representation and real-time dynamics. Remarkably, the discovery of these features is entirely unsupervised, with no physical labels provided. We further establish that such features causally affect the corresponding observables predicted by NQS, by showing that targeted, post-training intervention on a single feature smoothly and monotonically steers the corresponding observable, while leaving the variational energy nearly unchanged. These results demonstrate that NQS are not merely functional approximators, but encode rich, interpretable internal representations of physical information. Our approach provides both a diagnostic and an intervention tool for NQS, and serves as a foundation for using mechanistic interpretability towards more reliable, transparent NQS.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经量子态（NQS）是量子多体波函数的一种表达能力强的变分拟设，但其内部机制尚不清楚。本文提出了一种利用稀疏自编码器分析NQS内部激活的系统方法，并提取出与物理可观测值（如序参量和磁化强度）强相关的特征。研究发现这些特征的发现是完全无监督的，并且通过对单个特征进行干预可以平滑地引导相应的可观测值，同时几乎不改变变分能量。这些结果表明NQS并非简单的黑箱模型。
authors: Zihao Qi, Christopher Earls

articles.title: Bit flips are erasures in dissipative cat qubits
articles.title_zh: 耗散猫量子比特中的比特翻转是擦除错误
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01375v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous quantum error correction (QEC) stabilizes a logical manifold through dissipative events that emit into output channels, which are typically accessible to measurement. These signals are often discarded, and whether they contain useful information about logical failures remains generally unclear. Using quantum trajectories, we show that in dissipatively stabilized cat qubits bit flips are not silent logical errors: each flip is accompanied by a strong, time-localized photon burst from the dissipative buffer. Photon counting and homodyne monitoring can therefore herald the loss of logical information without interrupting the autonomous stabilization: bit flips in dissipative cat qubits are erasures. More broadly, our results show that the emitted signals of engineered reservoirs can act as built-in failure monitors for autonomous QEC, turning rare logical faults into erasures available to a decoder and reducing fault-tolerance overhead. To this end, we develop a general framework, based on past quantum states and number-resolved master equations, to quantify the detectability of such logical failures in autonomous QEC from the emitted signal.
articles.abstract_zh: 自主量子纠错（QEC）通过耗散事件稳定逻辑流形，但这些事件发出的信号是否包含逻辑故障信息尚不明确。本文利用量子轨迹表明，在耗散稳定的猫量子比特中，比特翻转并非无声的逻辑错误，而是伴随着来自耗散缓冲区的强烈、时间局域的光子爆发。因此，光子计数和零差监测可以预示逻辑信息的丢失，而无需中断自主稳定。研究结果表明，耗散猫量子比特中的比特翻转是擦除错误，并且工程化储层的发射信号可作为自主QEC的内置故障监测器。
authors: Filippo Ferrari, Joachim Cohen, Vincenzo Savona, Fabrizio Minganti

articles.title: Quantum nonlocal correlations of anomalous weak values
articles.title_zh: 反常弱值的量子非局域关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01491v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Violations of Bell inequalities are a hallmark of entanglement, with only entangled states capable of exceeding classical bounds in standard Bell tests. Here we analyze anomalous weak values of the CHSH operator in pre- and post-selected (PPS) quantum ensembles, treating them as generalized bounds on Bell-type nonlocal correlations in the presence of post-selection. Fixing the overlap between the pre- and post-selected states, we compare three scenarios: unrestricted boundary states, one separable boundary state, and both boundary states separable. For each case, we derive both the maximal weak value for a fixed Bell operator and the maximal bound obtained by further optimizing over all CHSH operators. Our results show that post-selection and entanglement are distinct operational resources: post-selection alone can enhance correlations, but entanglement is necessary to exceed the corresponding separable PPS bounds, and their combination yields the strongest attainable correlations. We further show that the enhancement beyond the separable bound closely tracks the concurrence of the states that optimize the bounds, identifying entanglement as the source of the additional correlation strength. Finally, we show that nonlocal weak values provide post-selected entanglement witnesses, and we give a constructive protocol that detects every pure two-qubit source state with nonzero concurrence in the ideal state-adapted setting, even in regimes where the corresponding standard CHSH entanglement test is inconclusive. In this state-adapted setting, we explicitly construct the post-selection and CHSH measurements that achieve the largest possible separation from the separable PPS bound. More broadly, our results motivate hybrid protocols that combine post-selection and entanglement, with possible applications to improved quantum sensing, weak-value amplification, and quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 贝尔不等式的违反是纠缠的标志。本文分析了预选和后选（PPS）量子系综中CHSH算符的反常弱值，将其视为在后选存在下贝尔型非局域关联的广义界限。研究结果表明，后选和纠缠是不同的操作资源：单独的后选可以增强关联，但纠缠对于超越相应的可分离PPS界限是必需的，它们的结合产生了最强的可实现关联。此外，超越可分离界限的增强与优化界限的态的纠缠度密切相关。
authors: Ron Cohen, Avshalom C. Elitzur, Eliahu Cohen

articles.title: Symmetry conservation with Trotterization and Quantum Phase Estimation
articles.title_zh: Trotter化和量子相位估计算法中的对称性守恒
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01560v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum algorithms for quantum chemistry and other many-body fermionic systems work by expressing the Hamiltonian in a basis of qubits and fragmenting the Hamiltonian into a sum of products of Pauli operators whose exponentials are easily encoded on a quantum device. Applying the product of exponentials, known as Trotterization, leads to an error associated with the non-commutativity of operators. This error can lead to breaking the symmetries of the Hamiltonian because the fragments are not symmetry conserving in general. Nonetheless, many algorithms for time evolution rely on Trotterization, including time evolution and quantum phase estimation. We show that we can express the Hamiltonian in terms of Hermitian excitation operators which map to sums of commuting Pauli strings for any encoding and conserve symmetries corresponding to Abelian groups of symmetry operators. Symmetries corresponding to non-Abelian groups, on the other hand, are not fully conserved by Trotterized Hermitian excitation operators, so we developed ``operator kirigami'' to cut the sum of non-commuting operators by orthogonal projection and to fold terms together using unitary rotations. We tested pools of operators for small molecules and basis sets, and found that electron number and spin symmetry conserving pools led to greater errors that decreased for larger molecules and were negated with second-order Trotterization. Our work shows the potential for testing quantum computing algorithms on classical computers by adapting tools used in electronic structure theory with conserved symmetries.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子化学和其他多体费米子系统的量子算法通过将哈密顿量表示为泡利算符乘积之和来实现，但Trotter化会因算符的非对易性引入误差，可能破坏哈密顿量的对称性。本文展示了如何将哈密顿量表示为厄米激发算符，这些算符可以映射到可对易泡利串之和，并能守恒对应于阿贝尔群的对称性。对于非阿贝尔群的对称性，Trotter化的厄米激发算符不能完全守恒，为此研究开发了“算符剪纸”方法来处理非对易算符之和。
authors: Edith Leal-Sánchez, Fanny Vain, Jong-Kwon Ha, Ryan J. MacDonell

articles.title: A Validation Framework for Quantum Simulation of Spin Dynamics against Inelastic Neutron Scattering and Classical Simulation
articles.title_zh: 量子自旋动力学模拟的验证框架：对比非弹性中子散射和经典模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01568v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantitative validation of quantum simulations of dynamical spin response remains challenging because experiment, classical simulation, and quantum simulation do not produce the same native observables. This problem has become increasingly important as quantum simulation protocols for dynamical response have progressed from theory to hardware-level benchmarking against neutron-scattering data, while the longer term goal is validation in regimes that may eventually become classically intractable, including in future fault-tolerant implementations. Here, we develop a cross-pipeline validation framework for quantum simulation, using inelastic neutron scattering and classical many-body simulation as complementary experimental and computational anchors, based on explicit forward and inverse observable maps, covariance- or resampling-based uncertainty propagation, robustness tests for structured distortion, and a hierarchy of complementary metric families. The framework distinguishes stochastic uncertainty from robustness-induced distortion, carries both explicitly through the comparison chain, and uses the resulting metric-level uncertainty and distortion information to support layered validation at the pipeline, solver, and model levels. We also introduce actuator-aware feedback logic aimed at improving agreement without obscuring the physical origin of any remaining mismatch. We close by outlining future extensions of this methodology, including upstream uncertainty and distortion modeling, adaptive feedback, asymmetric validation beyond full classical benchmarking, fault-tolerant workflows, and community infrastructure for reproducible validation.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子模拟动态自旋响应的定量验证面临挑战，因为实验、经典模拟和量子模拟产生的原生可观测值不同。本文开发了一个用于量子模拟的跨管道验证框架，以非弹性中子散射和经典多体模拟作为互补的实验和计算锚点。该框架基于显式正向和反向可观测映射、基于协方差或重采样的不确定性传播、结构化失真鲁棒性测试以及互补度量族层次结构。该框架区分了随机不确定性和鲁棒性引起的失真，并将其明确地贯穿于比较链中。
authors: Gilles Buchs, Elaine Wong, Anshumitra Baul, Kathleen E. Hamilton, Arnab Banerjee, Stephan Eidenbenz, Gábor B. Halász, Keerthi Kumaran, Thomas Maier, Thomas Naughton III, Elijah Pelofske, Vincent Russo, Allen Scheie, Yigit Subasi, D. Alan Tennant, Akram Touil, Travis S. Humble, Andrew T. Sornborger

articles.title: Shallow Unitary Circuits for Kramers-Wannier Dualities
